recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: san francisco fog swallowing the skyline at dusk
late summer warmth trapped beneath the marine layer
iceland weighing whether to knock on europe's door again
memory learning to think inside the silicon itself
rust key-value stores pushing speed into new territory
monsoon waters rising in distant mountain valleys

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a lone vessel through thick bay fog by tapping when sonar echoes return — clear pings mean open water, muffled ones mean turn now.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm timing tap on echo returns
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each clean dodge briefly reveals a ghostly landmark silhouette before the fog reclaims it
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, echo intervals shrink, phantom obstacles multiply
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome fog layers with faint golden bridge silhouettes

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Route streaming data packets into the correct in-memory processing banks before buffers overflow — computation happens where the data already lives.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left or right to route packets
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a full bank triggers an instant cascade burst that clears the queue in one satisfying flash
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more packet types, faster conveyor speed, corrupt packets that must be rejected
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon circuit-board with glowing processing-in-memory nodes

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Deploy thumb-sized agents onto a floating codebase map — tap to spawn, drag to connect nodes, race the clock before agents time out mid-task.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: tap deploy + drag to connect paths
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: parallel agents finishing together creates a synchronized completion burst across the map
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more nodes activate, tighter timeouts, conflicting agent paths that collide
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: terminal-green wireframe on dark canvas, iOS shortcut glyph aesthetic

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Drift a skiff between volcanic islands collecting runes that spell a word — draw your path, release to commit, one wrong island resets the chain.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: draw a path, release to commit
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: completing a word triggers an aurora wash across the entire sky
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: currents strengthen, islands shift position, draw windows get shorter
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor nordic seascape with aurora streaks
